description_en: This operation obtains a list of recommended managed rules
description_zh: 本接口用于获取推荐的托管规则列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-recommend-managed-rules --next-token IWBjqMYSy0is7zSMGu160000 --max-results 200 --region-ids-scope cn-hangzhou --exclude-region-ids-scope cn-shanghai --resource-group-ids-scope rg-aekzc7r7rhx0000 --exclude-resource-group-ids-scope rg-bnczc6r7rml0000 --resource-ids-scope lb-5cmbowstbkss9ta030000 --exclude-resource-ids-scope 236426606356870000 --selected-managed-rule-identifiers ram-user-last-login-expired-check --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRecommendManagedRules

parameters.help_en: The token that specifies the position from which to start the query. If this parameter is left empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。默认值：200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The scope of region IDs. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID范围。多个地域ID用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule does not take effect on resources in the specified regions. The resources in the specified regions are not evaluated. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定地域内资源无效，即不对该地域内资源执行评估。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule takes effect only on resources in the specified resource groups. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则仅对指定资源组ID中的资源生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule does not take effect on resources in the specified resource groups. The resources in the specified resource groups are not evaluated. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源组ID中的资源无效，即不对该资源组内的资源评估。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule takes effect on the specified resources. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源ID生效。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule does not take effect on the specified resources. The specified resources are not evaluated. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包对指定资源ID无效，即不对该资源执行评估。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en:
The managed rules that have been selected. Separate multiple rule identifiers with commas (,).
The system does not recommend managed rules that are of the same resource type as the selected managed rules
parameters.help_zh:
已选择过的托管规则，多个规则用半角逗号分隔。
不会推荐已选择托管规则对应资源类型的相关托管规则
parameters.name: selected_managed_rule_identifiers

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned for the request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求返回结果的最大记录条数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used to initiate the next query.

If this parameter is left empty, no more results are returned
NextToken.description_zh:
下一个查询开始的Token。

如果为空，则说明无下一页

Description.description_en: The description of the managed rule
Description.example: If the hotlink protection feature is enabled for the OSS bucket and the Referer is added to a specified whitelist, the configuration is considered compliant.
